description:
A desktop app that generates image previews and compressed videos of formats such as HEIC photos and HEVC videos, ensuring proper display of Synology Photos files on any devices


Important Note
1. The version is expected to be available in all regions within the next few days. The actual time of release may vary slightly depending on the region.
What's New
macOS
1. Enhanced compatibility with Apple silicon Mac models.
Bug Fixed
macOS
1. Fixed an issue where preview generation might stop unexpectedly.
2. Fixed an issue where some large previews could not be generated.
Windows
1. Fixed an issue where generated previews for H.264 videos might appear blurry.
2. Fixed an issue where the browser extension could not detect the desktop app when signed in with a non-admin DSM account.
